items.title: A Name Signed in Full
items.pitch: Fund the adult reading lessons an older resident has privately requested. A later memoir may preserve that person's voice while making a child face a family story they preferred to leave untold.

present_hook.what_you_notice: An unsigned adult-course application survives beside a family notebook written by other hands. A library display has no first-person account from the older resident.

clues.line: {A} asked about reading lessons in {year}. The cost and travel plan were never settled.

window.notes: A is B's parent. Require A's own request, an available qualified adult-learning service, actual preserved family memories and B's private preference not to discuss the specified non-sensitive family business failure. Present must be at least 25 years later.

interventions.how_it_looks: Cover the requested course, travel and materials without making attendance compulsory.

ripples.headline: Adult Learner Completes a Chosen Reading Course
ripples.body: {A} completed the requested course through actual lessons and practice. The learner signed the completion record in full.

ripples.headline: Older Resident Writes a Checked Family Account
ripples.body: {A} completed a first-person family account and checked its factual claims against surviving records. A failed family venture appeared among the remembered events.

ripples.headline: Family Memoir Enters the Library with Mixed Reactions
ripples.body: A funded edition of the memoir by {A} entered the library. Adult child {B} regretted renewed discussion of the verified old business failure.

fails.headline: Funded Course Does Not Become a Completed Qualification
fails.body: {A} did not complete the requested course within its funded window. Actual lessons remained part of the learner's experience, and unspent money remained accounted for.

present_day.best: In {now}, the library has an actual first-person memoir and A's signed course record. Later survival and reading ability follow ordinary history; the book remains if its author dies.
present_day.worst: First-step failure supplies no invented literacy or memoir. A retains dignity, agency and any actual learning achieved outside this chain.
present_day.twist: The learner gains a way to tell a personal story, while a family member loses the quiet surrounding an old failure. Giving someone a voice does not decide what they will say.

npc_lines_after.line: I wanted my parent to have those words. I was not ready for that chapter.

new_rules_needed: Select years and independent rolls keyed by seed, scenario ID, intervention year, roles and step. after_years counts from intervention. Check prerequisites before rolling; failure or ineligibility stops descendants but preserves earlier consequences. fails is the complementary first-step result, never a separate roll. Apply actions once. Persist actual people, objects, sites, funds and knowledge; replay invalidates descendants. Recheck survival, ownership and resources. Gate present text and dialogue on surviving recorded outcomes and informed living speakers. No forced unrelated deaths or duplicate rewards.

teach_skill requires actual voluntary adult instruction, practice, access accommodations and observed incremental achievement. Do not equate literacy with intelligence or erase partial learning on failure; debit only actual course costs.

compile_work contains A's own recorded memories and independently checked public facts. Do not invent a trauma, debt or family scandal to supply drama; bind the already-known ordinary business failure.

publish_work requires A alive and consenting, a funded edition, lawful rights, factual review and consent or redaction for protected third-party material. B's discomfort concerns a verified public business event, not a coerced private disclosure. Gate B's line on step 3, B alive and actual reading or discussion of that chapter. This long-survival branch grants A no extra lifespan.
items.era_notes: Use period-appropriate adult education and physical writing materials. A plain signed page is a meaningful artifact in every decade.
items.why_fun: The changed present contains sentences the original town never had in that person's own hand. The family reaction keeps the gift from becoming a scripted gratitude reward.

items.title: The Organ That Became a Wedding Business
items.pitch: Invest in a music store's instrument-restoration work. Restoring the church organ may eventually support a paid wedding venue, leaving local couples with fewer free dates in their familiar hall.

present_hook.what_you_notice: A silent church organ has an unfunded repair estimate. The hall's original calendar offers many free community wedding dates.

clues.line: {A} proposed restoring the organ in {year}. The specialist tools never reached the music store.

window.notes: shop belongs to A. Require A's genuine restoration competence, an authentic repairable organ, a consenting hall authority and B's later viable venue-management proposal. Present must be at least 29 years later.

interventions.how_it_looks: Fund the documented specialist equipment and restoration-work reserve.

ripples.headline: Specialist Restoration Returns the Church Organ to Service
ripples.body: {A} completed the commissioned organ restoration using the funded specialist equipment. Inspection approved the instrument for its actual operating conditions.

ripples.headline: Hall Approves a Funded Wedding-Service Trial
ripples.body: The hall authority approved a funded wedding-service trial organized by {B}. The working organ formed part of the venue's advertised offering.

ripples.headline: Reception Annex Opens with a Revised Hall Calendar
ripples.body: A funded reception annex opened beside the hall. Its approved booking agreement reserved dates for paid weddings and reduced the old supply of free community dates.

fails.headline: Organ Restoration Cannot Pass Its Completion Inspection
fails.body: The restoration proposed by {A} did not pass completion inspection within budget. No playable instrument was credited to the failed project.

present_day.best: In {now}, a working organ, reception annex and published booking calendar identify the venue. Actual free dates are fewer while the paid booking agreement remains active.
present_day.worst: First-step failure creates no approved organ performance or scenario venue service. Ordinary worship and community activities continue under their actual arrangements.
present_day.twist: Preserving a shared instrument can help turn a familiar public gathering place into a business. The venue may sustain its maintenance while feeling less available to local couples.

npc_lines_after.line: I am glad the organ plays again. We had to choose another hall to find a date we could afford.

new_rules_needed: Select years and independent rolls keyed by seed, scenario ID, intervention year, roles and step. after_years counts from intervention. Check prerequisites before rolling; failure or ineligibility stops descendants but preserves earlier consequences. fails is the complementary first-step result, never a separate roll. Apply actions once. Persist actual people, objects, sites, funds and knowledge; replay invalidates descendants. Recheck survival, ownership and resources. Gate present text and dialogue on surviving recorded outcomes and informed living speakers. No forced unrelated deaths or duplicate rewards.

restore_instrument requires actual specialist competence, funded parts and labor, owner permission and inspection. Investment funds equipment once; the organ is a distinct existing object, not new merchandise.

establish_event records an actual recurring service with lawful hall agreement, staffing, demand, fees and maintenance allocations. B must be qualified and consenting; successors can operate it after B's death.

Step 3 requires a Main Street hall site, lawful funded construction and a publicly reviewed booking agreement preserving required community uses. Add reserve_dates: assign only explicit calendar slots to the paid service, publish remaining free availability and expire reservations if the service ends. Gate the line on step 3 and an actual local couple whose requested affordable date was unavailable.
items.era_notes: Use the organ's actual construction and the hall's religious or civic authority; do not assume a particular denomination or marriage rite.
items.why_fun: The player can hear the restored instrument and read the calendar that followed it. A preservation success can change who feels the building is for them.

items.title: The Witness Whom People Finally Heard
items.pitch: Truthfully recommend a dismissed witness whose account could reopen an old conviction. A freed resident may eventually leave town, while the witness pays for a case that brings no lost years back.

present_hook.what_you_notice: A conviction record conflicts with a preserved fire-inspection report. A witness statement was never examined in the funded review that might have followed.

clues.line: {A} offered a corroborated account in {year}. The case against {B} was never reopened through that statement.

window.notes: Require B actually wrongly convicted in the bound case, A's genuine material account, corroborating non-sensitive evidence and an available lawful review process. Present must be at least 28 years later.

interventions.how_it_looks: Spread a truthful recommendation that the preserved witness account deserves a proper review.

ripples.headline: Preserved Witness Account Secures a Funded Case Review
ripples.body: The account given by {A} and its corroborating records secured an independent review of the conviction of {B}. Reviewers treated the statement as evidence to test, not a verdict.

ripples.headline: Final Review Overturns a Wrongful Conviction
ripples.body: A final ruling overturned the bound conviction of {B} and ended its remaining restrictions. {A} paid a documented contribution toward independent review costs.

ripples.headline: Cleared Resident Uses a Settled Award to Begin Elsewhere
ripples.body: {B} received the adjudicated compensation award and completed a voluntary move. The corrected case remained in the town archive after the resident left.

fails.headline: Recommended Statement Does Not Secure a Timely Review
fails.body: The recommendation of {A} did not produce a funded review within the scenario window. The actual evidence remained preserved and other legal remedies stayed available.

present_day.best: In {now}, the archive records the overturned conviction and B's voluntary departure. B is an out-of-town person with a continuing life, not erased from the world.
present_day.worst: First-step failure does not prove B guilty or destroy the evidence. The actual case and any independent remedies follow ordinary replay.
present_day.twist: Hearing the witness can free a person who then cannot bear to stay. A loses savings, the town loses a resident, and neither compensation nor correction returns the years already spent under the conviction.

npc_lines_after.line: I am glad the record changed. I wish this had become a place where staying felt possible.

Apply actions once. Persist actual people, objects, sites, funds and knowledge; replay invalidates descendants. Recheck survival, ownership and resources. Gate present text and dialogue on surviving recorded outcomes and informed living speakers. No forced unrelated deaths or duplicate rewards.

The positive rumor concerns A's actual preserved account and diligence, not guaranteed innocence based on popularity. Bind the objectively wrongful baseline case, statement and corroboration; change public attention without changing truth.

Add overturn_conviction: require competent independent legal review, admissible corroboration, completed lawful proceedings and a final order. Remove only the bound conviction and its remaining restrictions; retain truthful history of the original process and no invented release if B was already free.
A's fifteen percent debit is a real agreed contribution to a priced review fund, not a payment that buys a judgment. Require sufficient funds and independent decision-making.

Add compensate: pay the actual adjudicated amount from a funded liable authority, with no percentage-of-poverty shortcut or duplicate awards. move_away requires B's actual plan, means and consent and preserves person ID and history. Gate A's line on step 3, A alive and knowledge of B's departure.
items.era_notes: Use the jurisdiction's actual review and compensation rules for the event decade. Keep the fictional fire and conviction non-graphic.
items.why_fun: The successful present includes both a corrected page and someone who chose not to remain nearby. Justice changes history without canceling its cost.

items.title: The Dog That Brought Someone Home
items.pitch: Feed a lost dog beside the route a child takes home. Returning the animal may begin a friendship and a later bequest, eventually turning an empty property into a refuge whose barking changes the neighborhood.

present_hook.what_you_notice: An abandoned outbuilding has a faded lost-dog notice in its owner's papers. The original estate sold the property without the local animal-care use later proposed.

clues.line: {C} lost the dog in {year}. Child {A} passed the search route without finding it.

window.notes: Require C's actual tagged lost dog, A's supervised route, B owning the bound neighboring home, C's voluntary estate-planning capacity and ordinary baseline natural death 10–12 years later. Present must be at least 30 years later.

interventions.how_it_looks: Offer a suitable carried portion of food to the identified lost dog beside the permitted search route.

ripples.headline: Child Helps Return a Tagged Dog to Its Owner
ripples.body: With adult help, child {A} returned the tagged lost dog to {C}. The introduction grew into a supervised neighborly friendship.

ripples.headline: Settled Estate Leaves a Property to a Young Adult Friend
ripples.body: After the natural death of {C}, a valid settled estate transferred the identified property to adult beneficiary {A}. The bequest followed years of friendship rather than a promise made for returning the dog.

ripples.headline: Inherited Outbuilding Reopens as an Inspected Animal Refuge
ripples.body: {A} opened a funded inspected animal refuge in the inherited outbuilding. Its care operation brought real barking to the neighboring residential boundary.

fails.headline: Food Does Not Bring the Lost Dog to the Search Route
fails.body: The food did not attract the identified dog within the search window. No child-owner meeting was created through this attempt, and the ordinary search continued.

present_day.best: In {now}, the inherited outbuilding has a refuge entrance and actual cared-for animals, subject to ordinary survival and operating history. Neighboring sound follows real occupancy and schedules.
present_day.worst: First-step failure neither kills the dog nor denies normal search help. No scenario friendship, bequest or refuge follows from this attempt.
present_day.twist: A small kindness can help create a haven for animals and still make a nearby home less quiet. The original dog need not survive for the later idea to matter.

npc_lines_after.line: I am glad the animals have somewhere safe. I hear the good deed every morning.

proposed_verbs.does: Consume one actual safe appropriate food portion from player inventory at the permitted route and make it available to the specifically identified dog. Model attraction and consumption without guaranteeing trust or return. Do not feed unsafe food, create an animal, alter ownership or send a child alone into danger.

Add persistent animal IDs, tags, ownership, welfare and location only if the game supports this proposal. return_animal verifies C's actual ownership and uses a supervised safe handover; no instant human gratitude payout or ownership change.

Step 2 requires C's actual natural death, A at least 18, a freely made valid will with independent safeguards, completed probate and no dispossession of protected heirs or creditors. Never cause C's death or imply a lost-dog return earns an estate by contract.

Add establish_refuge: require A's actual animal-care competence, lawful inherited title, funded construction and operation, capacity limits, staffing, veterinary access and neighbor review. Refuge is a new civic operating type, not a free profitable shop.

Add animal_noise: calculate real sound from actual animals and care schedules at B's bound house under lawful welfare/noise rules. Provide mitigation and ordinary complaint responses; do not make the refuge a license for neglect or illegal nuisance. Gate B's line on step 3, B alive and currently living with actual modeled refuge sound.
items.era_notes: Use physical tags, notices and era-appropriate animal-care standards. Preserve the dog's finite lifespan instead of keeping one mascot alive for thirty years.
items.why_fun: The first ripple has four paws; the last has a front gate and a morning soundscape. The friendship matters without making the animal immortal.
